prompt: This photorealistic photo captures a sunlit carpenter's workshop filled with intricate details and natural textures. In the center foreground, a carpenter wearing a plaid shirt sands a wooden chair leg, sawdust flying around his hands. To his left, a sturdy oak workbench holds a hammer, a chisel, and a measuring tape, all arranged neatly. A tabby cat sits on a stack of lumber to the right, grooming its paw while observing the activity. Behind the carpenter, a large window lets in bright daylight, illuminating floating dust particles and highlighting the grain of the wood. On the far left, a younger apprentice carries a heavy plank of pine, walking toward the workbench. A coffee mug sits on a shelf in the background, next to a radio playing softly. The carpenter’s tool belt hangs on a hook nearby, filled with various implements. The lighting is natural and directional, creating realistic shadows and highlights on the surfaces. Every object, from the rough bark on the logs to the smooth finish of the chair, is rendered with extreme clarity. The scene conveys a sense of craftsmanship and dedication, with each element contributing to the authentic atmosphere of a working woodshop environment.
